RogerAI provides private inference networks for the edge, that means you and your homelab, that means factories and their fleet. Our labs focus on enabling open models to run on a spectrum of hardware . Our network runs one OpenAI-compatible local endpoint only you have access to, in a privatized relay on top of community and private hardware. It handles discovery, routing, failover, metering, and signed receipts.
